thread:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: SEV2 alert — automated regression detector flagged large quality drop for tenant AcmeBank on dedicated-pool-3.
Metric summary: perplexity +3.2x, top-5 answer mismatch rate 42% (baseline 5%).
Affected build: gpt-open-7b-quant-v2 (quantization profile v2).
Dashboard: <https://dash.redwood/internal/regr/1745009990>
---
sanjay: picking this up. tagging @olivia oncall-ml. acme-cs aware?
ops-pager: paging oncall-ml @olivia (pagerduty) :bell:
olivia: oncall-ml here, joining now. quick question — is this strictly quality (hallucinations/incorrect tokens) or are we also seeing latency/CPU/GPU errors?
sanjay: latency looks stable, no error spike in prod metrics. it's a quality-only signal reported by our eval hooks + customer complaints.
beth: AcmeBank on the call — they started seeing hallucinations in finance reporting templates around 09:10 UTC. They can reproduce with a few prompts.
olivia: thanks. likely vector: quant profile v2 introduced more aggressive weight rounding. we rolled v2 to dedicated-pool-3 in a staged rollout yesterday.
kevin: I can push a tenant override to force the previous profile. prefer revert quant profile for tenant or pin to non-quantized variant?
sanjay: let's be conservative. immediate mitigation: pin tenant to known-good variant gpt-open-7b-fp16 (non-quant) while we investigate v2. Then later we can evaluate reintroducing v2 with tenant-specific tests.
olivia: agree. plan: 1) apply tenant override in dedicated-pool-3 -> gpt-open-7b-fp16 2) run quick validation set (10 prompts from Acme) 3) confirm with customer 4) open postmortem and block autopromote for v2 into dedicated pools.
kevin: applying override now. command I will run:
```
redwoodctl tenant update --tenant acmebank --pool dedicated-pool-3 --model gpt-open-7b-fp16 --version 20240201 --reason "emergency revert - quality regression"
```
kevin: executing...
kevin: returned 200 OK, routing table updated for acmebank to gpt-open-7b-fp16 on dedicated-pool-3.
olivia: running quick eval against the 10 customer prompts saved in /evals/acme/last-10.json
```
[09:27:12] eval-runner: loading 10 prompts
[09:27:18] eval-runner: avg BLEU improved from 0.42 -> 0.79 vs baseline
[09:27:20] eval-runner: sample outputs look reasonable, fewer hallucinations
```
beth: relaying to Acme — they are testing now, holding on the call.
Acme (via beth): "initial tests look much better, some noise remains but acceptable for production"
sanjay: good. changing incident status -> mitigated. oncall-ml, can you hold the revert until we collect logs and attach to incident? also please timestamp the change.
olivia: noted. revert applied at 1745012000 UTC (approx). collecting model inference traces and KV cache stats now.
ops-pager: incident-bot update — mitigated, severity reduced to SEV3.
kevin: uploading logs to incident folder: s3://redwood-incidents/1745009990/logs.tar.gz
```
aws s3 cp /tmp/logs-1745009990.tar.gz s3://redwood-incidents/1745009990/logs.tar.gz
```
olivia: preliminary root cause hypothesis: quant profile v2 introduced a different bias in weight rescaling for some attention heads — manifests for financial templates with numeric entity handling. need model-level unit tests per tenant workload before rolling v2.
sanjay: agreed. immediate action items:
- (olivia) run deeper diff between v1 and v2 outputs on Acme prompt corpus (assigned)
- (kevin) block autopromote of quant-v2 to dedicated pools and remove schedule (assigned)
- (beth) coordinate follow-up with Acme SRE + PM, confirm acceptance of revert & timeline for permanent fix (assigned)
- (sanjay) draft customer-facing incident summary and next steps (assigned)

olivia: starting analysis, will post findings in this thread. suspect models/quant compilation path for fp16->int8 fallback.
beth: Acme asks for ETA on permanent fix — can we give rough estimate?
sanjay: short answer: we'll need ~3 business days to validate and produce a safe v2 candidate with tenant-specific evals; will update within 24 hours with initial RCA and mitigation timeline.
ops-pager: recorded: incident handled by sanjay, olivia, kevin, beth. mitigation: tenant pinned to gpt-open-7b-fp16.
sanjay: closing the live mitigation phase. leaving thread open for RCA and postmortem. tagging @olivia for investigation updates; @beth keep customer informed. :white_check_mark:
incident-bot: incident state archived to incidents/1745009990 after mitigation.
